description: Cache Status Indicator Fixes - Make the header cache indicator render on every authenticated route, hide when local-first sync or article caching is off, and show a neutral 'No items yet' state instead of a misleading green '100% cached' when there is nothing to cache. Eliminates the contradiction between the header indicator and the /settings cache section.

userStories.title: Implement blurhash-jobs consumer happy path (fetch, decode, encode, write)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a queue consumer worker that takes a job, safely fetches the image, decodes and resizes it with @cf-wasm/photon, encodes a BlurHash, captures intrinsic dimensions, and writes the result to KV and D1.
acceptanceCriteria: Consumer registered for the `blurhash-jobs` queue using the bindings from US-007
On batch receive, for each job: re-check `BLURHASH_KV` first (another worker may have hashed it); on hit, write hash + dimensions to D1 and ack without re-encoding
Image fetch uses `AbortController` with a 10 second timeout
Image fetch uses a browser-like User-Agent header
Reject images with `Content-Length` greater than 5 MB before reading the body
Backstop check rejects images whose actual received bytes exceed 5 MB
Decode → resize to 32×32 (nearest-neighbor) with Photon → encode with `blurhash` at 4×4 components
Capture `image_width` and `image_height` from the original decoded image (before resize)
Photon image instance's `.free()` is called in a `finally` block
Write hash to `BLURHASH_KV` with 90-day TTL
Write `blurhash`, `image_width`, `image_height` to the item's row in D1
Successful jobs ack the message

Lint passes

userStories.title: Implement blurhash-jobs consumer failure-mode policy
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the consumer to map each failure mode to the correct retry/skip/DLQ outcome per the table in `DOCS/PRD-blurhash.md` §7.5, so transient errors retry and permanent errors stop wasting CPU.
acceptanceCriteria: 4xx fetch response → permanent skip; ack the message; item row stays NULL
Decode failure (Photon throws on the bytes) → permanent skip; ack the message; item row stays NULL
Oversized image (Content-Length or actual bytes > 5 MB) → permanent skip; ack the message; item row stays NULL
5xx fetch response → throw to trigger retry
Fetch timeout (AbortController fires) → throw to trigger retry
KV write failure → throw to trigger retry
D1 write failure → throw to trigger retry
Photon crash mid-encode (other than decode-rejection) → throw to trigger retry
After the queue's `max_retries = 3` exhausts, the message lands in `blurhash-dlq` (verified by config, not behavior change)
Permanent-skip cases never enter the retry path
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
